front.title: Consent Receipt Binding for Task-Scoped Authorization

abstract.t: This document defines a signed consent receipt for task-scoped authorization between local agents. A receipt records a user's decision to allow or deny a described action, binds that decision to a task, an agent, an audience, an action set, and a resource set, and can be verified offline. The document also defines the consent request, the reservation ordering that avoids a circular dependency between a receipt and a capability token, the audit events that accompany consent and side effects, and an informative mapping to ISO/IEC 27560. It does not define a user interface, a transport, or a capability token format.
